node.statement: Defect bounds from the same axioms: let R=L_U^{-1}(J), so ||R||<=3 and U bold-dot R=J. Exact unitality and U^dagger bold-dot U=J, followed by one associator estimate, give ||U^dagger-R||<=epsilon_r||U||^2||R||<=12*epsilon_r; hence ||U bold-dot U^dagger-J||<=25*epsilon_r. Therefore the defect of U^dagger is at most 25*epsilon_r. Further, (U bold-dot V)^dagger=V^dagger bold-dot U^dagger. Reassociating (V^dagger bold-dot U^dagger) bold-dot(U bold-dot V) to V^dagger bold-dot(U^dagger bold-dot(U bold-dot V)) costs at most 20*epsilon_r because ||U||,||V||<=2 and ||U bold-dot V||<=5. Replacing U^dagger bold-dot(U bold-dot V) by (U^dagger bold-dot U) bold-dot V=V costs at most 8*epsilon_r before left multiplication, hence at most 17*epsilon_r afterward. Since V^dagger bold-dot V=J, the defect of U bold-dot V is at most 37*epsilon_r<=40*epsilon_r. All inequalities are non-strict, so the epsilon_r=0 case is included.
